node: HBM and advanced-packaging sub-suppliers below memory producers
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for direct public companies exposed to HBM and advanced-packaging sub-supplier bottlenecks. The best-fit candidates in this pass are not HBM producers but enabling tool, test, inspection, metrology, and bonding-equipment suppliers. FormFactor and Camtek have the clearest HBM-specific evidence from company sources. Kulicke & Soffa has direct advanced-packaging thermocompression bonding exposure but HBM linkage is broader and should be verified at the customer/order level. Onto Innovation is a larger process-control and advanced-packaging tools name with AI/advanced-packaging evidence, but HBM-specific revenue sensitivity needs further confirmation.
